bounds: Not production readiness or full SDK parity. Shared/public Bank remains rejected.
At-most-once unit effects are not arbitrary external exactly-once or ACK-loss crash certification. Incomplete Started fails permanently and does not replay callback.
Crash partial case is three acknowledged Proxy replies, not necessarily three Reboot mutations; natural random routing is unchanged.
Host binding is exact local running owner and recovery cancellation root, not distributed Database CAS or malicious detached custom registrar containment.
Serving initializer supports gRPC host in this vertical; no equivalent HTTP initializer or cross-state-type alias migration acceptance.
Proof artifacts are canonical RPC protobuf re-encodings, not raw RocksDB wire bytes; Load/Export are separate snapshots guarded by parked/stopped preconditions.
15 gates combine unchanged SDK/native stages with current public/consumer stages; failed earlier public stages retained, not credited. Ignored tests are not passes.
Fork CI approval and merge-result validation are external/unexecuted gates.
